alex: quick q — we're adding selection_policy + model_override to the /v1/infer contract. if model_override can't be honored (capacity/compat), what should we return to callers? cc @maria @sam

maria: short answer: don't 4xx. return 200 with the normal response shape and include served_model + fallback_reason (string code). keep existing top-level fields unchanged so clients don't break.

sam: +1. also propose an explicit deprecation window for old param model_hint (accept it but log warning header). want backward compat for at least 90 days.

alex: ok. example payloads would help — want the exact fields we agree on so SDKs can parse deterministically.

maria: example request (allowed params):
```json
{
  "input": "summarize...",
  "selection_policy": "prefer",    // enum: pin | prefer | hint
  "model_override": "rw-bert-7b-q4f",
  "region_hint": "us-east-1",
  "tier_hint": "hosted"
}
```
example response when override can't be satisfied but we can serve a compatible variant:
```json
{
  "id": "resp_abc",
  "output": "...",
  "served_model": "rw-bert-7b-q4f-compat-ptq",
  "fallback_reason": "override_not_available",
  "served_from_variant": "true"
}
```
Note: served_from_variant kept as string for now (SDKs expect string), but we can change to boolean in next major if needed.

alex: that looks fine. two follow-ups: (1) precedence between region_hint and tier_hint, (2) should selection_policy=pin ever cause a 4xx if absolutely impossible?

jin: precedence proposal from routing team: explicit model_override (pin) > selection_policy enum > region_hint (soft) > tier_hint (soft). so we never 4xx for routing failures: if pin can't be satisfied, we fall back and set fallback_reason=pin_rejected or no_capacity. only return 4xx for malformed requests/auth.

teja: from product side — callouts we need in the changelog and rollout: deprecation of model_hint, new enums, exact fallback_reason codes (pin_rejected, no_capacity, incompatible_arch). also mention stability window for served_model field ordering.

alex: thanks. I'm about to open the PR with the schema change and the example docs. pinging reviewers: @maria @sam — can you take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1876

ci-bot: PR #1876 — checks passed ✅ (lint, unit, contract-tests).

maria: quick code-review notes — please add a migration test that verifies old clients (using model_hint) still get served_model in the same place. also add an integration test for selection_policy=pin -> fallback_reason header.

sam: I'll schedule a canary tomorrow 09:30 PT. @jin please watch the oncall runbook and be ready to rollback if fallback rates spike.

jin: on it. I'll add a Prometheus alert for fallback_reason != "" to surface anomalies during canary.

alex: great. I'll update the PR with tests and the changelog blurb today. tagging this thread for async Q&A. ping again when PR is ready for final review. :thumbsup:

teja: thanks — we'll also surface the change in the Console release notes.

alex: PR updated with tests + changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1876/files — ping reviewers again @maria @sam

ci-bot: re-run checks — all green. deploy staged cluster tomorrow.

sam: thanks everyone.

alex: thanks :pray:
